findings.details: All original science is in a branch-local pack; notes lack canonical metadata/runner bindings, JSON-only output lacks canonical counted/N5 envelope. Preserve complete proofs and exact historical failures; capture only final reviewed canonical bytes.

Gaussian note section 7 names main Riesz/source-variation source only in prose. Geometry application names draft event sources; its infinite Z4 law additionally relies on the path-limit input through BLOCK04. Use actual canonical links with scoped dependency roles; 8165 remains conditional pending its independent review.

Original N1 checklist explicitly declines formal certification and does not give five normalized attempted routes. Convex section 5 asserts small principal flux need not guarantee globally small raw-curl lift and cites currents/harmonic sectors. The general torus distinction also appears in integer section 4. These topological exclusion statements must not receive packet PASS from one witness or formula mutations. Preserve exact originals; accept only positive conditional construction plus explicit statement that compact transfer is unestablished by this work, unless a genuine applicable certificate is separately completed. Preserve original branch if this exclusion/certification remains unlanded.

claims_and_boundaries: Bridge: positive Dirichlet grid precision and bounded Hessian give synchronous transport, all-p entrywise Green majorants, cubic F/R derivative estimates, then finite-volume physical-time limit. Constants independent of volume; no periodized compact log-derivative claim.

Convex extension: C2 clipped source, C4 potential and actual interacting bridge correction give global Hessian/cubic estimates and exact small-raw-curl equality for chosen lifts; interpolation carrier b(theta) retained.

Gaussian comparison: quotient actual nullspace; magnetic covariance factors into spatial curl projection, weighted diagonal Riesz ratio and small Neumann correction. Replication transfers published dimension-independent diagonal bound. Uniform cubic remainder yields only covariance-convergent diffuse-test Gaussian subsequences, not covariance identification.

Geometry: finite-set bad-vertex intersections plus Lambda(c)<1 imply finite enlarged-box components. Integer coordinate contraction fills conserved finite currents; disjoint actual components justify probability products. Contractibility gives integer lift and optional infinite/open-time temporal gauge. Application remains conditional on actual 8165 path/event bounds.
proof_obligations: CONDITIONAL: all four stated positive model/geometry implications are supported by their written proofs and disclosed mathematical tools; compact normalized measure/source matching is outside those implications.

imports.supplied_model: Compact rotor Hamiltonian, continuous angles, positive g and physical time, spatial cubic domains and boundary choices are supplied model data, not derived from framework axioms.
imports.comparison: Nonperiodic convex extension and alpha,T,g are explicit choices; no fitted or observed target.
imports.geometry: Finite-set probability bound is an explicit premise; Hamiltonian application requires separately reviewed path/event results.
imports.mathematical_tools: Finite-dimensional additive-noise flows, Brascamp-Lieb, Feynman-Kac, integer cellular cohomology, discrete Calderon-Zygmund interpolation and published diagonal Riesz theorem.
imports.registered_primitives: Authority memo and all three primitive sources read at frozen main. No registered primitive used as a bounded wall or enlarged into dynamics.

no_go.N1: Fewer than five actually normalized attempted routes against the topological exclusion are documented. Coefficient mutations and distinct positive lemmas do not repair this quota. Mathematical truth is separate.
no_go.N2: No independent physical-wall count claimed; analytic chain and geometric premise not independent walls.
no_go.N3: Model, domains, time weights, norms and probability premise are explicit.
no_go.N4: Finite source checks match their stated finite algebra; none tests normalized compact transfer.
no_go.N5: Four JSON final receipts omit required five-line certificate; canonical actual execution must add honest resolution statements.
no_go.N6: Normalized winding representation and direct response remain open positive routes; no new axiom required.
no_go.N7: Exact normalized compact winding/source map could enable transfer; no class-wide failure conclusion accepted.
no_go.N8: Earlier Hessian/path work supplies narrower inputs, not proof of compact transfer.
no_go.positive_scope: The four main implications are positive conditional results, not five failed attacks or impossibility claims.
no_go.required_disposition: Preserve stronger original exclusion in exact history and original branch if certification remains deferred; canonical accepted scope only asserts that this work has not established compact transfer.

read_scope.complete_science: All four complete proof notes; four full final runners; actual helper closure; mutation harness and focused verifier; all prior-source changes and diagnostics; all operational markdown and STATE; all 12 final mutation transformations and assertion stderr checked.
read_scope.numeric: All 17 nonempty JSON files parsed; final source/helper pins verified. Not every numerical leaf manually inspected.
read_scope.authority: Frozen main axiom memo, registry procedure/data and all primitive sources; same-revision review setup/units/lenses/fixes/audit-compatibility/salvage/operations, no-go discipline and proof-search governance. Governance context inspected; no current-main authority is inferred from moving checkout.

dependencies.reason: Sections 1-3 source variations and section 7 periodic Riesz proof only. Carrier expansion/physical-state claims are not imported.
Conditional application temporal event and infinite-volume path premise; itself uses BLOCK03.

external_sources.inspected: Definitions and Theorem 1; mixed cyclic groups explicit; only diagonal combination bound imported.
Primary source identity and covariance-tool scope; standard finite strongly convex covariance inequality used with verified hypotheses.

independent_controls.box_anchor_count: Exact inequality, 16 is sufficient for overlap factor; 4096 conservative.
independent_controls.scope: Independent finite/algebraic controls; no primary rerun, no all-volume simulation.

targeted_mutations.scope: Two targeted changed-runner mutations against independently differentiated positive integral; primary main not run.

resource_plan.memory: Largest primary eigensystem is 768 square; largest Hermite rule uses 16^4 points in 4 coordinates. Individual dense float64 768-square matrix is 4.5 MiB, but several coexist and LAPACK/Python overhead is additional. Peak RSS not measured; do not restamp historical time as resource certification.
resource_plan.runtime_inputs: No external scientific data read by original primary runners. Convex imports bridge helper and hashes both. NumPy/SciPy/mpmath required. Canonical wrappers must declare any newly read notes/helpers.
